title: Source display governance handbook
summary: This iteration makes the fixed source-first display order maintainable. It adds machine-readable governance metadata to the source display contract, a deterministic validator that checks contract and handbook alignment, and a readable handbook that explains ownership, baseline ranking, insertion rules, status preservation, and validation commands.

lessons.lesson: A fixed source-first order needs a machine gate, not only a handbook.
lessons.evidence: The new validator checks maintenance metadata, source coverage, unique ranks, package validation wiring, and required handbook markers.
lessons.recommended_action: Run `npm run sources:display-contract` whenever editing source ranking, handbook text, or logical source definitions.

lessons.lesson: New source insertion should use logical-source rules before collection-entry details.
lessons.evidence: The handbook distinguishes logical source placement from RSS, HTML, GitHub, platform, or manual collection entrypoints.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding a source, choose the logical source section and rank first, then wire one or more collection entrypoints underneath it.

followups.action: Use the handbook as the review surface for the user's manual tuning of fixed source importance before expanding the logical source list further.
